overview: No reliable direct-listening verdict on Japanese intonation was obtained. Do not treat the earlier preference for the unconverted source as verified.

how_it_works.premise_tested: An evaluator receiving uploaded WAVs can reliably perceive non-speech acoustic content, rather than merely describing the transcript.
how_it_works.calibration: C is the first 12 seconds of B plus a 1000 Hz tone at 5.00–5.45 seconds; D is the same speech without that tone. Ground truth was not disclosed in the prompts.

control_verification.comparison_resampling: D resampled from 40000 to 44100 Hz for verification only; original uploads unchanged

how_it_works.acceptance_gate: Identify the added non-speech sound in the correct file before relying on subjective prosody judgments. Passing this gate alone would not establish native Japanese accent expertise.

attempts.input: Full A/B blind comparison, followed by C/D in a separate chat
attempts.observation: Preferred B initially; retracted incorrect scene and final-sentence descriptions after a challenge. The separate control response explicitly said it could not access the audio.
attempts.decision: Reject the initial naturalness preference and phrase-level claims as verified listening evidence.

attempts.input: C then D, in a fresh temporary chat; UI reported 386 audio tokens per file.
attempts.observation: Claimed no acoustic difference and clean speech with no effects in both files. Did not identify the known added tone.
attempts.decision: Calibration failed; no A/B naturalness verdict requested on this route.

attempts.input: C alone, in a fresh temporary chat; no prior response or control answer supplied.
attempts.observation: Explicitly stated that it could not access or hear the audio and could not judge background sounds.
attempts.decision: Calibration failed; no A/B naturalness verdict requested on this route.

gotchas: A failed control does not establish that an entire model family is incapable of audio perception. It makes these specific evaluation attempts unsuitable as listening evidence.
C is 44100 Hz and D is 40000 Hz because of FFmpeg mixing negotiation. Both are 12 seconds. D was resampled only for local signal verification; original uploads were unchanged.
The AI Studio Get code snippet contains INSERT_INPUT_HERE, not the actual request body. It cannot establish whether audio was omitted in transport.
The original and converted WAVs were preserved unchanged. No generator, voice profile, or script changes were made during this listening investigation.
No paid upgrade, API-key creation, or Google Drive access grant was performed. The original AI Studio model setting was restored and the created tab was closed.
remaining_acceptance: A working, calibrated audio-perception evaluator or a Japanese-speaking human listener is required to assess intonation. Human direct listening has not occurred.

principles.Prove It Works: Rejected plausible naturalness descriptions when actual audio controls failed.
principles.Attack the Premise: Tested whether successful WAV attachment implied usable auditory perception instead of continuing to tune the voice based on unverified descriptions.
